additional_concerns: The offer-level candidates node.968dbccb08282a4e8a580ae5 and node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6 combine an offer-level promotional link with an existential gift classification. They do not expressly require the same gift component to have that promotional link. A mixed offer could therefore be caught without establishing the component-specific connection required by u13.

Candidates node.2a6321b4ce90763bf0be564e, node.97af37a2579f59b0ee43211f, node.968dbccb08282a4e8a580ae5 and node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6 place offering or promotional conditions in Scope. Their failure produces OUT_OF_SCOPE rather than FALSE. Preserve the alternative interpretations: these conditions may define applicability, or they may be substantive negative answers to the stated caught-by-the-restriction question. The typed question does not expressly resolve this distinction.

Likewise, node.6d6e7adc6faa9d94b74c08e5 returns OUT_OF_SCOPE when the promotional link is absent. Whether that should instead mean satisfaction of this selected control needs an explicit question-domain convention.

The circular defines distributors by reference to SFC-authorised funds in u0. The broader wording of some candidate facts is acceptable only within that retained source scope; it does not establish application to every investment-product distributor.

The gift classifications remain supplied judgments. Under u12, guaranteed returns or incentives 'may be considered a gift'; neither automatic gift classification nor automatic exemption is established. Passing the gift control also does not establish compliance with section 103 or the separate advertising duties.

Full external validation of the gift standard would require paragraph 3.11 of the Code of Conduct and the answer to question 1 of the SFC FAQs issued on 30 September 2010, referenced in u29. Full validation of the separate advertising framework would require paragraph 2.3, the named Advertising Guidelines, and applicable supplementary FAQs and guidance. These authorities are not supplied as dependencies; no dependency IDs can be assigned. Their absence does not negate the circular's explicit statements assessed below.

The packet does not establish a concrete effective interval or supply historical versions of the external authorities. The runtime's temporal uncertainty handling does not itself establish which legal version applies.
